overview: The primary page specifies porcelain flooring, fitted wardrobes and equipped kitchens. Its construction gallery is dated September 2026.
research.locationNote: Town Square Dubai. Confirm the selected home’s position and outlook.
research.priceNote: On 31 October 2026, Property Finder captures varied between AED 915,000 and AED 900,000 in selected-listing headlines; its older FAQ quotes AED 809,888. Developer stock is marked sold out. No authoritative current unit quotation was retrieved.
research.paymentNote: Original calendar: six 10% instalments followed by 40% at handover. This is equivalent to Property Finder’s 10/50/40 summary; elapsed dates are not a new booking offer.
research.handoverNote: The same official sheet says May 2027 in its heading and April 2027 in the handover box. Both fall in Q2; confirm the contractual month.
unresolved: 3BR A prints 1,384.99 ft² despite component sums of 1,384.13/1,385.85. Printed totals are provisional; request corrected dimensions.
